reader.requirement: For a relative file whose file connector is external, every file control entry of the run unit for that connector must specify the same access mode (an omitted ACCESS MODE clause being sequential, GR1), and the RELATIVE KEY data-name-1 of each entry must be an external data item and the same one in every entry; the compiler refuses a group whose describers disagree.

edition-consulted.switches: edition.DialectLevel >= 2023 gates the FILE STATUS and LINAGE external-item rules (not this rule); DialectLevel < 2002 picks CheckFileDescriptions over CheckFormat (FD clauses, not this rule); edition.Cite picks the citation text. The RELATIVE KEY not-external (COBOL1624), RELATIVE KEY same-item (COBOL1575) and access-mode agreement (COBOL6847, ACC segment) arms run unconditionally.
ConstructRegistry relative-key-clause-alone-2002: at 85 RELATIVE KEY must be a phrase of the ACCESS MODE clause (COBOL0900 otherwise); the 1985 format of the clause, not this rule's agreement

reader.edition-search: Read ExternalFileConnectorRules.Check and FileEntryIdentity.Segments whole; grep of DialectLevel/Cite in them.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the three refusals fire identically at 85 and 2023 (COBOL6847 at the same entry at --std 2023, only the citation text differs)
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witnesses exercise the same-item and other-positions halves; access-mode disagreement, a non-external RELATIVE KEY, differing external item names, and an entry that omits RELATIVE KEY are covered only by this read's probes

probes.expected: refused: entries specify RANDOM and DYNAMIC (GR8 first sentence)

probes.printed: error COBOL1624: the RELATIVE KEY data item 'REL-KEY' shall be an external data item (ISO §1985:VIII.2.4.4 GR8)

refused: same name REL-KEY at other positions of the external record is not the same external data item

citations.check: OK  §1985:VIII.2.4.4 GR8  (2.4.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR8
OK  §1985:VIII.2.4.4 GR1  (2.4.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR1

reader.notes: All three halves of GR8 (access-mode agreement, external RELATIVE KEY item, the same item in every entry) are refused at compile time across the compilation group; separately compiled describers are compared at run time by ExternalTable through the same FileEntryIdentity segments (not probed: run_probe compiles one source). The omitted ACCESS MODE clause is normalized to sequential and agrees with an explicit SEQUENTIAL.

refuter.evidence: r1-group-differ.cob (refute-1985-243/runs/r1-group-differ-001): two programs, one EXTERNAL relative file, both write ACCESS MODE IS RANDOM RELATIVE KEY IS REL-KEY; both describe 01 EXT-KEYS IS EXTERNAL with REL-KEY PIC 9(4) at characters 1-4, under a group named GA in R1A and GB in R1B. --std 85: error COBOL1575 at (37,54) 'shall specify RELATIVE KEY naming the same external data item, the same name at the same character positions of the external record' -- both stated conditions hold (same name REL-KEY, same positions 1-4, same record EXT-KEYS), yet it refuses. Same refusal at --std 2023. Control r1-same-ctrl.cob (no intermediate group): exit 0, B[SECOND-REC]. r1-name-differ.cob (REL-KEY vs REL-KEY2, both characters 1-4 of EXT-KEYS): COBOL1575 too. Cause: DataItem.ExternalItemIdentity keys on the full dotted name path from the EXTERNAL root (EXT-KEYS.GA.REL-KEY vs EXT-KEYS.GB.REL-KEY) plus offset/width, so a subordinate group name the RELATIVE KEY phrase never references makes two descriptions of the same storage 'different items'. 1985 lets subordinate descriptions of an external record differ freely: only the record-name and the size must agree (X.4.5.4 GR2), and a program may redescribe the record (GR1). kb/Work PB5857 decided 'the same external data item is the same storage' -- the probe's two REL-KEYs are the same storage. cite.py: 'OK  §1985:VIII.2.4.4 GR8  (2.4.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR8' ('must reference that same external data item in each case'); 'OK  §1985:X.4.5.4 GR2  (║4.5.4 General Rules║)  the text is in GR2' ('each record-name of the associated record description entries must be the same'); 'OK  §1985:X.4.5.4 GR1  (║4.5.4 General Rules║)  the text is in GR1'. Known note: none for the name-path half (PB5857 added the offset but kept the subordinate names; grep of kb/Work for ExternalItemIdentity finds no note on intermediate group names). The reader's other halves (access mode COBOL6847, non-external key COBOL1624) stand.
edition-sites-missed: src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Compiler/Binding/Model/DataItem.cs#ExternalItemIdentity: no edition switch; its name-path component is the defect, at every edition
refuter.corrected: NONCONFORMING (harm rejects-legal-source, cause b: same at --std 2023). Minimal repro r1-group-differ.cob: REL-KEY at the same characters of the same external record EXT-KEYS in both describers, reached through differently named intermediate groups, is refused COBOL1575 although it is the same external data item under 1985 X.4.5.4 GR1/GR2 and kb/Work PB5857's storage reading. ExternalItemIdentity should identify a corresponding external data item by record name + storage (offset, width), not by the subordinate names, which 1985 does not require to agree. Whether a differently named item at the same storage (r1-name-differ) is 'that same' item is the same storage reading; it too is refused.
